vocabulary.definition: A shortened form of a word or phrase.
vocabulary.example: The abbreviation 'GSOH' stands for 'Good Sense Of Humour.'

vocabulary.definition: A statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is.
vocabulary.example: He made an exaggeration about his experience to impress the interviewer.

vocabulary.definition: Involving or characterized by deception or misleading.
vocabulary.example: The deceptive advertisement led to disappointment among the customers.

vocabulary.definition: Creating a false online identity to deceive someone, usually for romantic purposes.
vocabulary.example: She realized she was being catfished when the person she was dating online turned out to be someone else.

vocabulary.definition: Pretending to have more liberal or progressive values or attitudes than one actually does, in order to attract others.
vocabulary.example: He was accused of wokefishing after pretending to support certain social causes just to impress his date.

vocabulary.definition: The opinion or feeling that someone or something gives you.
vocabulary.example: She tried to make a good impression during the job interview by dressing professionally.
